As Facebook (FB) Shares Declined, Shareholder Nomura Holdings Cut Position by $737.18 Million; Capital Planning Advisors Has Upped Celgene (CELG) Stake by $348,435
May 30, 2018 - By Richard Conner
Nomura Holdings Inc decreased its stake in Facebook Inc (FB) by 64.66% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Nomura Holdings Inc sold 4.67 million shares as the company’s stock declined 0.01% with the market. The institutional investor held 2.55 million shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $403.31M, down from 7.22M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Nomura Holdings Inc who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $537.65B market cap company. The stock increased 0.44% or $0.82 during the last trading session, reaching $185.74. About 14.93M shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 21.69% since May 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.12% the S&P500.
Ken Heebner increased its stake in Celgene Corp (CELG) by 105.3% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Capital Planning Advisors Llc bought 3,915 shares as the company’s stock declined 18.51% with the market. The hedge fund run by Ken Heebner held 7,633 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $681,000, up from 3,718 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Capital Planning Advisors Llc who had been investing in Celgene Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $56.53B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.02% or $0.8 during the last trading session, reaching $77.83. About 4.86M shares traded. Celgene Corporation (NASDAQ:CELG) has declined 32.65% since May 30, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 45.22% the S&P500.
Analysts await Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) to report earnings on July, 25. They expect $1.72 EPS, up 30.30% or $0.40 from last year’s $1.32 per share. FB’s profit will be $4.98 billion for 27.00 P/E if the $1.72 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.69 actual EPS reported by Facebook, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 1.78% EPS growth.
